scope: Synthetic frozen mapped exports; no vendor account, captured private export, webhook or automatic integration is claimed.
identity: alo_record_ref is an explicitly retained opaque custom field or source-bound sidecar join. It is never inferred from email, name, row number or publisher domain.
dates: actual_event_at and source_event_id are explicit source-bound event fields in these mapped fixtures. Aggregate totals, launch dates, import timestamps and generic last-contact dates are not substituted for reply/bounce dates. Missing fields hold the row.

hunter.supported: Selected lead export with explicitly configured stable-reference, status and actual-event-date columns. Aggregate reporting CSV is not a per-prospect outcome input. Successful alone is held.

lemlist.supported: Documented sentAtN and repliedAtN step timestamps plus an explicit retained stable-reference/custom-variable column. Opens are ignored.

instantly.supported: Selected lead export with explicitly configured stable-reference, supplied status and actual-event-date columns. Export column spelling and event coverage must be checked for the selected file; no universal native header format is claimed.

nonEffects: No body/reply/contact email in normalized outcome payload
No independently verified win from provider success
